--- a/rich/prompt/promptbase.py
+++ b/rich/prompt/promptbase.py
@@ -166,3 +166,11 @@
             except InvalidResponse as error:
                 self.on_validate_error(value, error)
                 continue
-            else:
-                return return_value
+            else:
+                return return_value
+
+    def on_validate_error(self, value: str, error: InvalidResponse) -> None:
+        """Handle validation errors."""
+        message = error.validate_error_message
+        if not self.console.color_is_enabled:
+            self.console.print(f"Error: {message}")
+        else:
+            self.console.print(f"Error: {message}")
